surface_mechanism_description: The text discusses the deposition of HfO2 on GaAs substrates using atomic layer deposition (ALD) and mentions the use of Hf(NMe2)4 and water precursors. It indicates that the choice of metallic precursor can drive the surface chemistry toward the in situ removal of native oxide of GaAs. However, no specific surface reaction mechanism or chemical equations are provided in the text.
evidence: It is believed that an appropriate choice of metallic precursor can drive the surface chemistry toward the in situ removal of native oxide of GaAs and other III-V materials.
